title: Student Storage: Store Your Things Over the Summer
description: Student storage between terms and over summer: self storage, collection services and sharing a unit. How to pack, what to check and how to save.
cardText: Store your things between terms or over the summer, alone or shared with friends.
h1: Student storage: keep your things safe between terms
intro: Heading home for the summer or studying abroad? Student storage means you don’t have to ship everything home and back again.

image.alt: Packed boxes in a room by a window ready for storage

highlights.title: Free to use
highlights.text: Our guides and comparisons cost nothing. You book directly with the storage provider.

highlights.title: Compare before you book
highlights.text: Check size, access, security and the full monthly cost, not just the headline price.

highlights.title: Home or business
highlights.text: Advice for personal storage, business storage and everything in between.

sections.html:
• Self-storage unit: rent the smallest unit or locker that fits, near campus or near home.
  • Collection services: some companies collect boxes from your room and return them at the start of term. You pay per box or item.
  • Share a unit: splitting a unit with friends can cut the cost each, but agree in writing who pays what and who holds access.

• Book early: demand peaks at the end of the academic year
  • Ask about student offers, and check the price after any offer ends
  • Use sturdy, same-sized boxes and label each one
  • Don’t store food, and make sure everything is clean and dry
  • Check your insurance: student contents policies don’t always cover storage

faqs.q: What size storage unit does a student need?
faqs.a: A small locker or a unit of around 25 sq ft (about 2.5 m², or 5 × 5 ft) usually fits boxes, a bike and a few small items from a student room.

faqs.q: Can I share a storage unit with friends?
faqs.a: Often yes, but the contract is usually in one person’s name, and they’re responsible for payment and access. Agree how you’ll split costs before you start.
